title: Slow-Cooked Beef Brisket
subtitle: American BBQ-style oven-braised brisket
excerpt: A whole beef brisket rubbed with smoked spices and slow-cooked in the oven for four hours until it pulls apart easily. It needs almost no attention once it goes in, and the braising liquid reduces into a rich sauce. Serves six and the leftovers reheat well.
sourceNotes: Inspired by American BBQ brisket traditions, adapted for home oven braising without a smoker.

recipe.freezeNotes: Freeze sliced brisket in the braising liquid. Thaw overnight and reheat gently in the sauce.
recipe.makeAheadNotes: Brisket improves if cooked a day ahead. Refrigerate in the liquid and reheat gently, covered, at 150C for 30 minutes.

content.text: Brisket needs low heat and a long time. At 150C it becomes tender without drying out. You can use 4 crushed fresh garlic cloves in the rub in place of garlic powder; both work well.

items.prepNote: roughly sliced, for the base of the tin

content.text: Preheat the oven to 150C. Mix the smoked paprika, cumin, ground coriander, chilli flakes, and crushed garlic with 1 teaspoon of salt.
Pat the brisket dry and rub the spice mixture all over it.
Scatter the sliced onions over the base of a roasting tin. Place the brisket on top, fat-side up.
Pour the beef stock, Worcestershire sauce, and honey around the brisket.
Cover tightly with two layers of foil and roast for 4 hours until very tender. The meat should shred easily with a fork.
Remove the foil for the last 20 minutes to let the top caramelise.
Rest for 15 minutes before slicing or pulling. Strain the braising liquid and serve as a sauce alongside.

items.symptom: Brisket is still tough after 4 hours
items.cause: Oven temperature was too low or brisket was very thick
items.fix: Re-cover and return for another 30 to 60 minutes.

items.cause: Foil seal was not tight and steam escaped
items.fix: Add a splash of water or stock and re-seal before returning to the oven.
